text: as for the ball props. and really, most of these things, they should all carry collision physics and move, like a cone, ball, etc. i want to be able to kick around the ball for example by just running into it
resolution: Kickable props are in. The host physics integrator already stepped dynamic sphere bodies (gravity, world collision, bouncing, body-vs-body) but never resolved them against the PLAYER — so nothing could ever be kicked. Added capsule-vs-sphere contact in framework/game/physics.zig: running into a dynamic prop pushes it out of the player and transfers your approach velocity along the contact normal (scaled by the authored bodyRestitution tuning, 0.72), with a small upward pop on hard kicks — sprint into the soccer ball and it flies, bounces off walls and rolls out with per-kind bounciness. Which props are dynamic is data: a dynamics { bodyRadiusMeters, restitution } recipe on the kind definition — wired on all 3 balls (bouncy), the traffic cone and the trash can (low bounce, they shove/slide); adding more kinds (chairs etc.) is one line each. Placed dynamic props no longer emit static collision walls; the play route simulates them as host bodies, renders them live at their physics position, and keeps the resting-body idle discipline (no re-render storm). IMPORTANT: the Zig host changed, so the editor binary needs a rebuild before the kick is feelable — hot reload alone won't pick it up. Scope notes: wv_-painted world-layer props remain static for now; compiled no-V8 game parity for dynamic props is a follow-up. Verified: kinds/props 8/8, build 18/18, game/physics 15/15, zig ast-check, editor cart bundles clean.
